title: Decoding a Bit String of the Specified Shape
statement: Let $x$ be a bit string and $n,s,t$ natural numbers. Suppose its first field consists of $n$ doubled true bits followed by the delimiter $01$; its next $n^2$ paired-bit positions have equal bits in each pair and are followed by $01$; its next field is the binary expansion of $s$ with each bit doubled and followed by $01$; and its final field is the binary expansion of $t$, with no trailing bits. Assume also $s<n$ and $t<n$. Then there is a Boolean adjacency matrix $A$ on the vertices $0,\ldots,n-1$ such that $x$ is the prescribed nested pair encoding of the unary field, the row-major list of entries of $A$, and the binary expansions of $s,t$. Moreover, for every pair of vertices $u,v$, the bit of $x$ at position $2n+2+2(un+v)$ is true exactly when $A(u,v)$ is true.
